components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action colour: donate, browse causes, start a fundraiser.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-brand, #0b6b45); color: #fff; font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-deep, #08553a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink, #17201b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet outline pill beside a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-slate-300, #c9d0c9); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-card, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #17201b); font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, #17201b); background: var(--color-slate-50, #f6f7f5); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink, #17201b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-slate-700, #3d4741); } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-slate-300, #c9d0c9); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-card, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #17201b); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-slate-400, #97a29a); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-brand, #0b6b45); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(11 107 69 / 0.3); } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--color-slate-500, #5f6b63); }

components.name: Proof Chip

components.name: Almost There Badge

components.html: Almost there

components.name: Amount Preset
components.description: Donate dialog preset tiles; the suggested one carries a green pill tag.
components.css: .ds-presets { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding-top: 8px; font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-preset { position: relative; min-height: 56px; border: 1px solid var(--color-slate-200, #e1e5e0); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-card, #fff); color: var(--color-slate-700, #3d4741); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-preset:hover { border-color: var(--color-slate-400, #97a29a); } .ds-preset:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink, #17201b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-preset.is-selected { border-color: var(--color-brand, #0b6b45); background: var(--color-brand-soft, #e7f3ec); color: var(--color-ink, #17201b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-brand, #0b6b45); } .ds-preset-tag { position: absolute; top: -12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); white-space: nowrap; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-brand, #0b6b45); color: #fff; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; }

components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 360px; font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #17201b); } .ds-card-photo { aspect-ratio: 4/3; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-slate-100, #eef0ec); } .ds-card-meta { margin: 16px 0 6px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--color-slate-500, #5f6b63); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card-title a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card-title a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink, #17201b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title a { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; text-decoration-color: var(--color-brand-deep, #08553a); } .ds-card-tag { margin: 6px 0 16px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-slate-600, #525d56); } .ds-bar { height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-track, #e3e8e4); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-brand, #0b6b45); } .ds-card-money { margin: 10px 0 2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-money b { font-size: 16px; } .ds-card-money span { font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-slate-500, #5f6b63); } .ds-card-stats { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-slate-600, #525d56); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Fundy is built to the donation-site standard (GoFundMe, charity: water, Kitabisa, JustGiving): real photos, plain numbers, one green action, and Fundy's proof (checked campaigns, stage-by-stage payouts, public receipts) set exactly where the donor decides. Warm white grounds, near-black ink with a green cast, generous tap targets, and a single typeface carry the whole site. Novelty metaphors and the old navy-heavy institutional look are rejected.

The system is phone first and serves donors young and old equally: body text never below 15px, nothing smaller than 13.5px, 44px minimum targets, WCAG AA contrast, meaning never carried by colour alone, reduced motion respected. Dark mode is a deep forest night where green is the light.
keyCharacteristics: Fundy green is the only action and progress colour; amber appears only for "almost there".
Onest everywhere (Latin, Uzbek oʻ gʻ, Cyrillic); tabular figures for money.
Photo-led campaign cards with 16px corners and thick rounded progress bars.
Pill buttons and chips; 10px corners for inputs.
Flat at rest; soft shadows only on lifted panels and floating things.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Green is the only colour that means "do this" or "progress". No second action hue.

rules.name: The Amber Is Momentum Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only for a live campaign at 75-99% of its goal. It is a badge ground and an icon, never body text on white.

rules.name: The 13.5 Floor Rule
rules.body: The smallest text is 13.5px (the overridden `text-xs`); small body text is 15px. Do not use arbitrary smaller sizes.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount, percentage and count that can sit beside another is set in tabular figures.

rules.name: The Soft-Only Rule
rules.body: Depth is diffuse and tinted; no hard offset shadows, no coloured glows.

dos: Do use Fundy green for every primary action and every progress fill, with white text on it.
Do keep text at 15px or larger for reading and never below 13.5px for labels.
Do make every tap target at least 44px tall.
Do set money, percentages and counts in tabular figures.
Do use pills for buttons, chips and toggles, and 16px corners for photos and cards.
Do show selected state as green border plus green tint plus a 1px green ring.
Do carry state with shape or pattern as well as colour (solid vs dashed trail).
Do let progress fills grow in once (700ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) and stay still under reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce a second action colour or return to navy as a primary surface.
Don't use amber for text on white or outside the 75-99% "almost there" state.
Don't add a second typeface; hierarchy comes from Onest's weights.
Don't use hard offset shadows or coloured glows.
Don't put small uppercase kicker labels above headings.
Don't use coloured side stripes on cards or alerts.
